definition.summary: Storage axis: the copies of a parameter slot that declares a multiplicity.
definition.description: A `storage` axis is an addressing dimension of the stored form, not an axis of the computation. A parameter slot that declares a `multiplicity` is m tensors of its shape, applied independently — one per auxiliary stream, one per shared expert; for its location (Specification §3.4) and its D3 shape the slot has this axis first, local name `multiplicity`, extent m, so a `stack` over it takes one location per copy and a `tensor` takes the copies whole as [m, …]. It appears in no primitive shape: no semantic partition (§4.4), no flattening factor (O5.10) and no sharding permission follows from it. D3's `elements` is the product of the shape's extents, the declared count included once.
